# Michael Dattolo — Product Designer, Roboticist & Innovator

> Michael Dattolo is an award-winning product designer based in Hackettstown, NJ, working at the
> intersection of advanced manufacturing, robotics, and medical devices. He turns ambiguous problems
> into validated, working hardware and measurable outcomes. B.S. Integrated Product Design, Johnson &
> Wales University (GPA 3.9, Dean's List 2020–2024). Currently a Special Operations Specialist at Techflex.

documenting the problem, process, key decisions, and a measurable outcome. Use it to answer questions
about his experience, skills, and work.

## Case studies
- [EcoPrint — 5-Axis 3D Printing Waste Reduction](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/5-axis-3d-printing-waste-reduction/): Multi-axis additive-manufacturing workflow that reorients geometry mid-print to eliminate support material. Measured 37–44% reduction in support-material mass across overhang-heavy test geometries; 12–18% faster prints. Solo academic project.
- [Total Ergonomics Micropipette](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/total-ergonomics-micropipette/): User-centered ergonomic control add-on for a lab technician with rheumatoid arthritis. Comparative testing of three prototypes selected a foot-pedal design that reduced repetitive thumb strain.
- [The M.A.R.T.I.A.N. Construction Robot](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/martian-construction-robot/): Autonomous 8-legged robot that excavates and builds underground Mars habitats from local regolith. Topology-optimized structure; 5-step autonomous DIG workflow; validated in ROS 2 + Gazebo. Recognized at the 2024 JWU Symposium (Technology & Innovation).
- [BloominBeds Monitoring System](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/bloominbeds-monitoring-system/): Raspberry Pi sensor network with DHT22 sensors and a real-time web dashboard that keeps raised garden beds within safe growing conditions. Team project, recognized at the 2024 JWU Symposium (Creativity & Design).
- [EDISON AI Assistant](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/edison-ai-assistant/): Fully offline, multimodal AI platform with multi-GPU LLM inference, RAG memory, voice processing, and image generation, exposing an OpenAI-compatible API.
- [Artificial Magnetic Fields for Mars](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/artificial-magnetic-fields/): Parametric simulation of deployable electromagnetic radiation-shielding systems and field-control geometry for Mars habitats.
- [Storage Concepts](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/storage-concepts/): Modular and wearable personal-storage product concepts focused on modularity and manufacturability.
- [Growth Algorithm Simulation](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/growth-algorithm-simulation/): Computational/generative design exploring procedural growth, collision detection, and organic form generation in Grasshopper/Rhino.
- [Willie's Cafe Space Study](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/willies-cafe-space-study/): Observation-led spatial redesign with data-driven seating analysis and ADA compliance.
- [JRM Enterprises Feasibility](https://mike-dattolo.com/work/jrm-enterprises-feasibility/): Business modeling and launch planning for a specialty conversion-service concept, including market research and tiered pricing.
